reviews.reason: An explicit owner/session/record input change invalidates retained local resource/draft state; preserving it would leak the previous owner. NativeRuntimeSlotSurface projects an externally recreated renderIdentity into error state. A retry/identity change must clear only the prior runtime error; busy/error/last-ready content have separate ownership and must retain last good DOM during preparation. Reassessed 2026-10-29: The delta gives one automatic block an explicit viewport height and overflow contract, bypassing intrinsic measurement only in that mode. Width-lifecycle tests now assert viewport resizing, design footer allowance, fixed/free/multiple-block fallback and restoration. Page/session identities and runtime-error reset ownership remain unchanged.
